Given a category <MATH_0001> and an object <MATH_0002>
we define the <TEXTITOPEN_0001>category of objects over <MATH_0003><TEXTITCLOSE_0001>,
denoted <MATH_0004> as follows.
The objects of <MATH_0005> are morphisms <MATH_0006> for
some <MATH_0007>. Morphisms between objects
<MATH_0008> and <MATH_0009> are morphisms <MATH_0010> in <MATH_0011> that
make the obvious diagram commute. Note that there is a functor
<MATH_0012> which simply forgets the
morphism. Moreover given a morphism <MATH_0013> in
<MATH_0014> there is an induced functor
<MATH_0015> obtained by composition with <MATH_0016>,
and <MATH_0017>.
